items.reason: POST/PATCH handlers manually enforce workspace membership using enforceWorkspaceScoping(). withCanonicalEnforcement wrapper must be extended to support workspace enforcement for POST/PATCH handlers.
items.required_design_decision: Should withCanonicalEnforcement wrapper compute and enforce workspace membership in POST/PATCH? If yes, how should membership be validated? If no, separate wrapper needed?
items.notes: Requires wrapper design: (1) Extend withCanonicalEnforcement to validate workspace membership, or (2) Create separate wrapper for workspace-enforced mutations

items.reason: Some routes use resolveServerRole() for special role-based auth instead of capability-based auth. This custom role pattern requires separate design.
items.required_design_decision: Should custom role resolution be integrated into withCanonicalEnforcement? Or should it remain a separate route-level concern? How to unify role and capability auth?
items.notes: Out of scope for withCanonicalEnforcement. Requires custom role resolution design.

overall_assessment: Lane 8 cannot proceed with direct migration without design phase. Workspace enforcement requires extending withCanonicalEnforcement or creating separate wrapper. Custom role resolution requires separate design. Both are architectural decisions.
